title: Central Station and Docklands railway proposal

implementation.note: The original imagegen drafts remain design history. Runtime uses exact shared numeric earthworks, the existing playable road graph, two road approach overpasses, gated local crossings, solid platforms and a depot-roof landing pad. Moving train service is not part of this infrastructure update.

station.location: Northern Docklands, immediately south of Downtown's waterfront freeway
rationale: Close to Downtown with a pedestrian link under the freeway
Redevelops an industrial warehouse strip rather than the central parks or Old Town
Shares the northern rail approach with a freight connection to the port
Keeps the railway west of the river and away from the airport runway

railway.route: Northern map edge through the foothills, along the west bank of the Rivermere River, then branching to Central Station and dock freight sidings

crossings.majorRoads: Road-over-rail bridges at the northern freeway, central airport bridge approach and southern freeway
crossings.yardRoads: Gated level crossings with stop bars on quieter industrial roads

railway.stationAccess: Road-connected forecourt, pedestrian link to Downtown and platform access independent of active freight tracks

passengerOperation.train: Short passenger train with a driving cab at each end
passengerOperation.turnaround: Stop at the terminal platform, change the active driving cab, then reverse direction to depart. The train does not physically rotate.
passengerOperation.requiredTrackwork: Provide a crossover in the station throat so a departing train can join the northbound track from either platform.
passengerOperation.drawingLimitation: The generated overview does not clearly resolve the crossover switches. Detail and validate this trackwork before implementation.

railway.implementationCaution: These images are illustrative; trace the final rail geometry and individually resolve every street/rail intersection, approach grade and structural clearance before implementation.

helipad.recommendation: Optional rooftop pad on a separate low depot/operations building beside the station
helipad.rationale: A distinctive game landmark, separate from the platform canopy and passenger forecourt; evaluate open approach paths and nearby port cranes before implementation.
helipad.terrainRule: The heightmap represents ground and building foundations only. Model the elevated roof and pad separately.

heightmap.grading: Smooth rail formation, level station/depot foundations and dry freight yard pads
heightmap.limitation: Image generation changed unrelated values and some water-mask classifications. Do not replace reference-heightmap.png or regenerate height-data.js from this draft.
beforeImport: Trace and register the approved route against original source pixels
Preserve the original water mask and untouched terrain exactly
Build and validate a continuous rail grade at the game's compressed world scale
Keep bridges and rooftop structures out of the ground elevation raster

heightmapValidation.thresholdExplanation: The runtime source classifies grayscale <= 8 as water. Counts describe threshold changes in the image draft, not intended land reclamation.
